description: The largest open-source library of animated, interactive, and customizable React & Next.js components for building standout web products and experiences. Built for humans and AI agents.
readme: Animated React components for websites people remember. 215+ free animated components and backgrounds for React.Tune them yourself, or hand them to your agent. Documentation · Installation · MCP · Tools · Pro What's inside Every component has a live demo with controls, and comes in four flavors: JavaScript or TypeScript, styled with CSS or Tailwind. Category Count What you'll find Text Animations 33 Split text, typewriters, rotating words and scroll reveals Animations 38 Cursor effects, hover interactions, borders and image effects Components 48 Cards, navigation, carousels and galleries Micro 34 Buttons, toggles, indicators and other small interface details Backgrounds 63 Gradients, particles, grids and shader effects for whole sections React Bits Pro The complete React toolkit for crafting memorable UI. React Bits stays free forever. Pro takes you from individual effects to complete pages, product UI, templates and an Agent Kit, all delivered as source you own. "Everything about this is next level." — @shadcn "Paid once, and he keeps shipping updates. Easiest value I've gotten from any tool." — @juandadotdev Pay once, keep every update. Every file is yours to edit, and lifetime access includes every future update. Want to see how it fits your workflow first? Grab a free template and agent skill, no checkout needed. Installation Add any component with the shadcn CLI. The suffix picks the flavor: JS or TS, then CSS or TW. npx shadcn@latest add @react-bits/SplitText-TS-TW Or with jsrepo: npx jsrepo@latest add https://reactbits.dev/r/SplitText-TS-TW Prefer to copy by hand? Open a component's Code tab, pick your flavor and paste the files into your project. The installation guide covers both. Use it with your agent React Bits works with the shadcn MCP server, so Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code and Antigravity can find and add components for you. Add the registry to your components.json: { "registries": { "@react-bits": "https://reactbits.dev/r/{name}.json" } } Then connect your client, for example npx shadcn@latest mcp init --client claude, and ask for what you need. See the MCP guide for every client. Creative tools Five free tools for making assets and sounds with React Bits, right in the browser. Background Studio: browse every animated background, start from a preset and tune it live. Export the code, a high-resolution image or a looping MP4 or WebM video. Center Stage: turn a screenshot or screen recording into a polished product shot on lifelike phones, laptops and browsers, with 3D tilt, depth of field, shadows and type. Perfect for launch videos or demos. Export 4K images, 4K video, GIFs or a link. Shape Magic: design a logo mark from shapes, patterns, text or your own SVG, then give it a 3D material like chrome, glass or neon. Export SVG, PNG, favicons, video or React. Texture Lab: run photos, videos or your camera through 160 one-click styles and 75+ stackable effects, from ASCII and halftone to glass and glitch. Export images, videos or GIFs. Sound Lab: audition 200 interface and video sounds, tune them and add effects like reverb, echo and filter, then install one with a single command or download WAV, MP3 or OGG. Sponsors React Bits is supported by these sponsors. Become a sponsor to reach 500K+ developers every month. Diamond Silver Community Contributing. Ideas and fixes are welcome. Browse the open issues, suggest something with the feature request template, and read the contribution guide before opening a pull request. Official ports. React Bits is also available for Vue and Svelte. Contributors. Thanks to everyone who has helped build React Bits. Credit React Bits occasionally draws inspiration from publicly available code examples. These are rewritten as full-fledged, customizable components for JS, TS, CSS and Tailwind. If you recognize your work, open an issue to request credit. Some Texture Lab effects and Shape Magic materials are adapted from Paper Shaders (Apache 2.0) and Shaders.com by Shader Effects Inc. (MIT). The third-party notices for Texture Lab and Shape Magic list the adapted files and include the licenses. License MIT + Commons Clause, free for personal and commercial use.
